{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_no_qa = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Now, filter to loyal customers only
loyal_df = df_no_qa[df_no_qa['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal

print(f"Number of loyal customers (after removing QA): {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number converted: {converted_loyal}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
